B0H2VW2J1P.title: Linkind Matter Outdoor Smart Plug, Works with Alexa, Apple Home,Google Home
bullets: Important Compatibility Notes: A compatible Matter-certified hub or controller, such as HomePod, Echo, Nest, is required for Apple Home, Alexa, Google Home. Alternatively, the AiDot app can be used without a hub. This smart plug uses Matter over WiFi, not Thread. It supports 2.4GHz WiFi only, not 5GHz. It is not compatible with Zigbee, Smart Life, or Tuya. Supports 120V only and is not compatible with 220V or 240V systems. Energy monitoring is not supported.

Matter Outdoor Smart Plug — Direct Smart Home Control: Connect this smart outlet directly to Alexa, Apple Home, Google Home with Matter over WiFi—no separate manufacturer app required. Set up once and control your outdoor devices directly from one smart home platform, making everyday control simpler and more convenient. A Matter-certified hub or controller, such as HomePod, Echo Dot, Nest, is required for these platforms. Alternatively, use the AiDot app without a hub.

IP65 Weatherproof for Year-Round Outdoor Use: Built for outdoor conditions, this outdoor smart socket features IP65 weather resistance, ETL certification, and 15A/1800W capacity. Operates from -30°C (-22°F) to 50°C (122°F) for reliable performance in cold winters and hot summers. Designed for reliable outdoor use through changing weather conditions year-round. NOTE: Do not immerse in water. Install upright and avoid standing water.

Power & Upgrade Outdoor Devices: Give your existing outdoor devices smart control without replacing them. Connect Holiday String Lights, Landscape Lights, Christmas Tree Lights, Patio Lights, Outdoor Fountains, Pool Pumps, and other compatible devices to bring convenient smart home control to your outdoor setup.

Custom Timers & Schedules for Outdoor Automation: Create custom timers, recurring cycles, and automatic on/off schedules for your outdoor smart plug. Turn Holiday String Lights on at a set time in the evening, schedule Landscape Lights to run overnight, or automate Christmas Tree Lights, Outdoor Fountains, and compatible Pool Pumps—so your outdoor setup runs automatically without manual switching.

Voice, Remote & Group Control for Your Yard: Enjoy hands-free voice control when your hands are full, whether you're holding a child, cooking, or grilling outdoors. Control your outdoor devices remotely from anywhere when you're away from home, as long as the plug remains connected to your home WiFi—for example, turn on your outdoor lights before you arrive home for a welcoming, more secure-feeling entrance. Group multiple devices for one-touch control, making it easy to manage your outdoor setup and save time.

Up to 300 ft WiFi Range for Convenient Outdoor Control: Enjoy up to 300 ft of WiFi range to help extend coverage across your yard, patio, garden, or other outdoor areas. These WiFi plugs let you control compatible outdoor lights and devices more conveniently across a wider area. Supports 2.4GHz WiFi only and does not support 5GHz.

Easy Reset When Connection Issues Occur: When to Reset: If the device frequently disconnects or fails to connect, reset the device, then reconnect it to resolve most connection issues. How to Reset: Long press the Outlet 1 button for 10 seconds. At 5 seconds, the red and green lights will flash alternately—keep holding. Rapid red flashing indicates a successful reset. The device automatically enters pairing mode, with the red and green lights flashing alternately. Reconnect the device in the app right away.
